title: Your first SwordWeave session
subtitle: A run sheet to prepare, play and learn together
intro: Use this beside the Rules guide. Write your table's agreements and the changes that actually happen; these prompts add no new rules.

pages.title: Before the first scene
pages.purpose: Agree a small objective and give each player one usable starting point.

sections.title: Gather the table
sections.hint: Choose a way to pause, check comfort and change direction. Nobody needs to explain a boundary.

fields.name: tone
fields.label: Our setting, tone and things to leave out

fields.name: pause
fields.label: Our pause signal, check-in and planned finish time

sections.title: Choose the starting situation
sections.hint: Name a goal, a visible problem and another possible approach. An encounter's sample party budget is not a difficulty guarantee.

fields.name: objective
fields.label: What are we trying to achieve? What can we perceive?

fields.name: alternatives
fields.label: An approach besides a fight; what failure could change

sections.title: Check each character
sections.hint: Use the GM's agreed starting budget. Neris is a level-8 demo; review a fork before using it. Read the actual limits of one useful capability.

fields.name: party
fields.label: Players / characters / agreed level or BU / separate Item BU

fields.name: ready
fields.label: One usable capability, its supplies, and where to find current Vitality

checks: Sheets and dice or a dice roller are ready
Everyone knows the objective and pause signal
GM has read the encounter's pinned creatures and other approaches

pages.title: At the table, then after play
pages.purpose: Follow one declared intent through its result. Reuse the record for a decision that taught you something.

sections.title: Agree before resolving
sections.hint: Begin with intent. Ordinary actions may need no special purchase. For unusual behavior, inspect owned permissions; agree scope, resolution, stakes and any Cost before rolling.

fields.name: intent
fields.label: Who acts, what do they want, and what access applies?

fields.name: stakes
fields.label: Agreed scope, timing, roll / threshold, success and failure

fields.name: cost
fields.label: Agreed use Cost / supplies / duration and continuation point

sections.title: Resolve and carry the change forward
sections.hint: Use the displayed total once. In combat, coordinate Council and Fast / Measured / Heavy. Movement shares the round's allowance; reactions need their own valid trigger and available slot.

fields.name: roll
fields.label: Actual dice + displayed bonus = total; what happened?

fields.name: changes
fields.label: Vitality before / after; supplies spent; ongoing effects and their endings

fields.name: next
fields.label: The new situation and the next decision

sections.title: Keep the useful feedback
sections.hint: Record the rule / page or tool step, what you expected, what happened and any temporary ruling. Leave out other players' private information when sharing feedback.

fields.name: feedback
fields.label: One clear moment, one confusing step, and what we will try next

checks: Changed values and spent supplies recorded
Ongoing effects have clear timing and ending terms
Open questions saved with the version we used
